Based on my testing and analysis of the qlang language, here are the queries for all 14 tasks:

H1: /data | filter ~(if /active ~(if (at :address | type | eq ::map) ~(at :address | at :city | type | eq ::string) ~(false)) ~(false)) | * /name | sort ~(lower)

H2: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid" !| false) | * (/items | * (mul /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2

H3: /dependencies | keys * (:key / | {:name :key :version (/ | /dependencies | /:key)}) | append (/ | /devDependencies | keys * (:key / | {:name :key :version (/ | /devDependencies | /:key)})) | filter ~(/version | startsWith "^") | * (/name | keyword | append "@" | append /version) | sort ~(split "@" | first)

H4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * (at :assignee | at :login | coalesce "unassigned") | reduce {} ~(:k / | :prev . | (:prev | at (:k | keyword) | coalesce 0 | add 1 | :{(:k | keyword) .}))

H5: (:defaults /defaults | /services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq false | not) | * {:name /name :timeout (at :timeout | if (type | eq ::null) ~((defaults | /timeout)) ~(/)) :retries (at :retries | if (type | eq ::null) ~((defaults | /retries)) ~(/))} | sort ~(/name))

H6: filter ~(at :durationMs | type | ne ::null) | groupBy ~(/service) | * ((:sum (/ | * /durationMs | sum)) | (:count (/ | count)) | (:sum | div (:count)) | round 1)

H7: filter ~(/stock | type | eq ::number) | filter ~(/stock | gt 0) | sort ~(/price) | reverse | take 3 | * /name

H8: groupBy ~(/dept) | * (/ | * ((at :skills | coalesce []) | * (lower)) | flat | distinct | sort)

H9: filter ~(/role | lower | eq "db") | every ~(if (/region | eq "eu-west") ~((at :cpu | at :cores | gte 8) !| false) ~(false))

H10: split "; " | join "," | split ", " | join "," | split "," | * (lower | split "@" | last) | distinct | sort

H11: lines | * (split " " | {:timestamp /0 :method /1 :path /2 :status (/3 | parseJson) :duration /4}) | filter ~(/status | gte 500) | * /path | :counts (groupBy ~(/)) | (:counts | keys) | * {:path . :count (:counts | /.)} | sort ~(/path) | sort ~(/count) | reverse | take 2

H12: lines | drop 1 | * (split "," | {:name /0 :team /1 :score (/2 | parseJson)}) | filter ~(/score | type | eq ::number) | groupBy ~(/team) | * ((:sum (/ | * /score | sum)) | (:count (/ | count)) | :sum | div (:count) | round 2)

H13: lines | filter ~(ne "") | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | filter ~(contains "==") | * (split "==" | {:name (/0 | lower) :version /1}) | indexBy ~(/name) | * /version

H14: * (:total ((at :comments | coalesce []) | * (at :likes | coalesce 0) | sum) | {:title /title :total :total}) | sort ~(/total) | last | /title
